text:
165 PRs merged this week. Coding agents got new harnesses, MCP tools, and sandboxes to work in. The model shelf grew across images, audio, text, and decisions; chat got room for larger PDFs, audio, and images. We also connected app submissions to Quests, worked on the new Community pages, and made model evals easier to inspect. Quite a lot of gardening for seven days. Browse the work at github.com/pollinations/pollinations.
